success.description: Reduce the number of tracking tokens on target insanity by the number of {Da} generated on this roll. If this reduces the number of tracking tokens to 0, the insanity is cured.

conservative.requirements: Be able to see your light and must be suffering from a temporary insanity. Special: This check's difficulty is the severity of the target insanity - i.e., if the target insanity has a severity of 2, the difficulty is Average (2{Dc})

chaosStar.description: Move the target insanity from its original subject to you.

reckless.requirements: 1 power, target within close range. Target must be able to see your light and must be suffering from a temporary insanity. Special: This check's difficulty is the severity of the target insanity - i.e., if the target insanity has a severity of 2, the difficulty is Average (2{Dc})
